title: Interview with a young chef
instructions: Radyoda genç bir aşçıyla röportaj. Uzun bir diyalog; geçmişini, bugününü ve planlarını ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Today I'm talking to Can Demir, who won a big cooking competition last month. He's only twenty-two! Can, how did you start cooking?

script.speaker: b
script.text: My grandmother taught me when I was eight. Every Sunday, we made bread and soup together.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes. After school, I went to a cooking school in Istanbul for two years. Then I worked in a hotel kitchen in Bodrum.

script.speaker: a
script.text: What did you cook in the competition?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Fish with lemon and herbs, and for dessert, a pumpkin pudding. It's my grandmother's recipe!

script.speaker: b
script.text: Ten thousand pounds and a month working in a famous restaurant in London.

script.speaker: b
script.text: After London, I want to open a small restaurant in my home town, with simple, fresh food.
